note:
Malcolm, 2026-08-31: /pages/shipping-returns is a messy unstructured page and should be rebuilt on the theme's stock sections.

AUDITED THE LIVE PAGE FIRST. Three faults were structural, and two of them were bugs rather than layout taste:

  1. The best-organised content on the page was SWITCHED OFF. The multi-column section `shipping_overview` — three Shipping Zones cards carrying free/paid, transit time and carrier — has `"disabled": true` in the template and does not render at all. Nobody had seen it.
  2. The closing call to action was INVISIBLE. `cta` sets its heading to #ffffff and its button to a white fill, which is a block designed to sit on a dark ground, but the section carries no background at all, so white type was rendering on the theme's Bone #F0F0F0 page. 'Still have questions?' was white-on-near-white.
  3. `Returns & Refunds` rendered LITERALLY, entity and all. A `text` setting is escaped on output, so an ampersand written as an HTML entity gets double-escaped. The hero one line above it is written as a plain '&' and renders correctly — that is the proof. Richtext settings are unaffected because their HTML is emitted raw, which is why 'Delivery times & carriers' inside the prose was always fine.

AND THE PAGE SAID EVERYTHING TWICE. Three rich-text walls (1239px, 650px and 328px tall) restated all ten FAQ answers in prose: delivery times, costs, customs, changes, the 30-day window, free returns, refunds, exclusions, damaged orders. The prose is now cut back to the facts the structured sections do not already carry, and the FAQ keeps the question-and-answer form — it also feeds the JSON-LD in `faq_schema`, so it has to stay.

NOTHING FACTUAL WAS DROPPED. Fifteen policy facts were inventoried before the rewrite and every one survives: processing window, confirmation email, the eight country/carrier/transit rows, the estimates disclaimer, free-in-Europe and the checkout fee, EU VAT included, non-EU duties paid by the recipient, the two-hour change window, tracking, the 30-day return window, prepaid labels, the 14-day refund, the hygiene exclusion, the 7-day damage report, and the re-shipment cost on a bad address.

STOCK SECTIONS ONLY, no custom Liquid:
  hero               unchanged — the dark title band
  promises           NEW text-with-icons. A four-icon strip so the whole policy is scannable before any prose.
  shipping_overview  RE-ENABLED. The three zone cards that were already written and hidden.
  delivery_table     NEW specification-table. The eight-row country/carrier/days list was a table pretending to be a bullet list. max_rows is 8 so all rows show rather than collapsing behind the default 5-row 'View all' toggle.
  shipping_details   rich-text wall -> multi-column, four cards: processing, costs, taxes, changes.
  returns_policy     rich-text wall -> multi-column, four cards: window, free returns, refunds, exclusions.
  damaged_orders     kept as prose — it is genuinely prose — but centred at medium width so it reads as a closing note, not a fourth wall.
  faq                text_position start -> center. Start left the title alone in a wide empty column beside the accordion.
  cta                given the #1A1A1A ground its white heading and white button were always designed for.

Block ids change where a section changes type. Only `en` is published on this store, so no translation keys are orphaned — this would need re-checking before the other eight locales go live.

HEADING SIZES CORRECTED AFTER LOOKING AT IT. The first push set the card titles to h3, which renders at 36px in Fraunces — far too heavy for a four-up card, and 'What can't be returned' wrapped to two lines while its three siblings sat on one. Card titles are now h5 in the four-up rows and h4 in the three-up zone row, and the icon strip is back to the schema's own h5 default. The section titles stay h2.

settings.title: Returns & Refunds
settings.content: We want you to love your skincare. If something isn't right, here's how returns work.

If your order arrives damaged or faulty, or if tracking shows it as delivered but you haven't received it, email support@skingenetix.com within 7 days of the delivery date with your order number, and a photo if it's damaged. We'll resolve it quickly with the carrier — a replacement or a refund, whichever is appropriate.

Please double-check your shipping address at checkout. If a parcel comes back to us as undeliverable we'll contact you to arrange re-shipment, and re-shipping costs may apply.
